before.description: Only return orphaned jobs created before this date

count.description: Compute the exact total match count (count(*) OVER()). Set to false to skip this on callers that don't use the `total` response field and only sweep pages sequentially - it's otherwise recomputed on every page.

cursor.description: Keyset-paginate: only return jobs with id greater than this value (overrides page). Cheaper than page/limit for sweeping the full result set.
